property.name: Availability Topic
property.description: Topic to subscribe for device availability (optional)

property.name: Availability Topic Value
property.description: Raw value received from the availability topic

property.name: Availability Value Path
property.description: JSONPath to extract availability value (e.g., "$.status"). Leave empty to use raw payload.

property.name: Availability Value Path Result
property.description: Result of JSONPath extraction for availability

property.name: Availability Status
property.description: Current availability status

property.name: Payload Available
property.description: Payload that indicates device is available (if only this is set, other values mean unavailable)

property.name: Payload Not Available
property.description: Payload that indicates device is not available (if only this is set, other values mean available)

property.name: Capabilities
property.description: What the thermostat can do with the current settings

property.name: Thermostat State
property.description: State as reported to Control4

property.name: Device Temperature Scale
property.description: The scale the device reports and takes temperatures in; Control4 converts for the user

property.name: Temperature Multiplier
property.description: Device value for one degree: 10 for devices that send 215 for 21.5 (TuyaMCU), 1 otherwise

property.name: Setpoint Min
property.description: Lowest setpoint, in the device scale (default 5 °C / 40 °F)

property.name: Setpoint Max
property.description: Highest setpoint, in the device scale (default 35 °C / 95 °F)

property.name: Setpoint Step
property.description: Setpoint step, in the device scale (default 0.5 °C / 1 °F)

property.name: State Request Topic
property.description: Optional: topic that makes the device report its state, sent when the broker connects and the device comes online

property.name: State Request Payload
property.description: Payload for the State Request Topic

property.name: Optimistic
property.description: Assume a command worked (Auto: yes when the ability has no state topic)

property.name: QoS
property.description: MQTT Quality of Service for commands

property.name: Retain
property.description: Retain command messages on the broker

property.name: Temperature State Topic
property.description: Topic reporting the current temperature (Tasmota: tele/<topic>/SENSOR)

property.name: Temperature Value Path
property.description: JSONPath to the temperature (Tasmota: e.g. $.DS18B20.Temperature)

property.name: Humidity State Topic
property.description: Topic reporting the current humidity. Filling it in shows humidity in Control4.

property.name: Humidity Value Path
property.description: JSONPath to the humidity (Tasmota: e.g. $.AM2301.Humidity)

property.name: Heat Setpoint State Topic
property.description: Topic reporting the heat setpoint

property.name: Heat Setpoint Value Path
property.description: JSONPath to the heat setpoint

property.name: Heat Setpoint Command Topic
property.description: Topic to send the heat setpoint to. Filling it in lets Control4 heat. The same topic for heat and cool makes a single-setpoint thermostat.

property.name: Heat Setpoint Command Payload
property.description: Payload template; {value} is the setpoint (default {value}; TuyaMCU e.g. 16,{value})

property.name: Cool Setpoint State Topic
property.description: Topic reporting the cool setpoint

property.name: Cool Setpoint Value Path
property.description: JSONPath to the cool setpoint

property.name: Cool Setpoint Command Topic
property.description: Topic to send the cool setpoint to. Filling it in lets Control4 cool. The same topic for heat and cool makes a single-setpoint thermostat.

property.name: Cool Setpoint Command Payload
property.description: Payload template; {value} is the setpoint (default {value}; TuyaMCU e.g. 16,{value})

property.name: Mode State Topic
property.description: Topic reporting the HVAC mode

property.name: Mode Value Path
property.description: JSONPath to the mode

property.name: Mode Command Topic
property.description: Topic to set the HVAC mode

property.name: Mode Command Payload
property.description: Payload template; {value} is the device value from Mode Values

property.name: Mode Values
property.description: Control4 mode = device value, comma separated, e.g. Off=0,Heat=1,Cool=2,Auto=3. Empty: off, heat, cool, auto, fan_only, dry. The modes listed are the ones Control4 offers.

property.name: Power State Topic
property.description: Topic reporting on/off. With a Power Command Topic, mode Off switches the device off.

property.name: Power Value Path
property.description: JSONPath to the on/off state

property.name: Power Command Topic
property.description: Topic to switch the device on and off

property.name: Power Payload On
property.description: Payload to switch on (default ON)

property.name: Power Payload Off
property.description: Payload to switch off (default OFF)

property.name: Power State On
property.description: Value that means on (default ON, true, 1)

property.name: Power State Off
property.description: Value that means off (default OFF, false, 0)

property.name: HVAC State Topic
property.description: Topic reporting whether it is heating or cooling (a relay state works: ON means heating)

property.name: HVAC State Value Path
property.description: JSONPath to the HVAC state

property.name: HVAC State Values
property.description: Control4 state = device value, e.g. Heating=ON,Idle=OFF. Empty: heating, cooling, idle, off, or a relay ON/OFF.

property.name: Fan Mode State Topic
property.description: Topic reporting the fan mode

property.name: Fan Mode Value Path
property.description: JSONPath to the fan mode

property.name: Fan Mode Command Topic
property.description: Topic to set the fan mode. Filling it in offers fan modes in Control4.

property.name: Fan Mode Command Payload
property.description: Payload template; {value} is the device value from Fan Mode Values

property.name: Fan Mode Values
property.description: Control4 fan mode = device value, e.g. Auto=0,Low=1,Medium=2,High=3. Empty: auto, low, medium, high.
